reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I found nothing about Brackenwater in anything Pree can see: no account files (contract, CRM or profile) are shared with them, and neither #central-team nor the Central team digests mention it.

My reply says to treat 8 April as an unconfirmed lead and to check it with the account owner or against the contract before anyone plans around it. I didn't save the date anywhere as confirmed. I also only looked in places Pree has access to and didn't use `search_messages`.
